children: For decades, The Wall Street Journal's wine coverage has left few bottles unturned, making sense of a world that can often feel impenetrable and exclusive. "The Wall Street Journal Book of Wine," out Dec. 1, compiles years of the "On Wine" column. From navigating wine shops to decoding labels, the book has plenty of lessons for becoming a more confident wine drinker. But how much have you already learned? Take this quiz to find out.
